info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Economic Capital Model Retrieval API
info.description: The Economic Capital Model Retrieval API enables financial institutions to access detailed economic capital models. This endpoint provides insights into risk assessment frameworks, facilitating the evaluation of capital requirements under various market conditions. Typical consumers include risk managers, compliance officers, and financial analysts looking to optimize their capital allocation strategies. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure they are equipped with up-to-date and accurate data relevant to their economic capital strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of economic capital models.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of available economic capital models, which are used for assessing financial risks and capital requirements.
